remarks: Brook House - your retreat in North Stamford. Bring your handyman or contractor. This property is for that special person who does not mind the work involved. The exterior needs paint and some repairs. The landscaping requires commitment. Lush gardens, Japanese Maple and Mountain Laurel. Many different flowers will bloom all summer. There are 3 Bedrooms and 3 Full baths. Front and South entrances have Stone Bridges over a calming, babbling Brook, hardwood floors throughout; and some may be the original, wide planked. Central A/C.  Flagstone, Covered Patio on the South side. The 2-car garage is deep providing storage and work areas. The built-in workman's counter, and Wood Burning stove which vents to the outside is for the DIY enthusiast. Extra Refrigerator (2-yrs old) in garage. Off the deck, in the rear of the home is a fenced-in dog run. Other things to note: Newer Breaker Box; Newer Washer/Dryer; Gasoline powered Generator; Several Skylights throughout the upper level. The 4th bedroom was used to increase the Primary Bedroom and its closet space and the closet in the 2nd Bedroom. Homeowners share Snow plowing of the road. Last winter's share was $231. The pictures were taken before the owner moved out.  You think you are choosing a house, but you are choosing a lifestyle.
